Orchid Regional Airways' check on WO-2620 loses its 12,000 monel blind rivets until 27 Oct against a 19 Oct induction, moving redelivery 4 days. Saone Rivets is the only other approved rivet source and quotes 28 days, so the near-term fix is stock and sequencing, not resourcing.

rationale: The 704 rivets in INV-0021 let Orchid Regional Airways' check start on 19 Oct with riveting sequenced after the 27 Oct delivery, and moving four pin lines to approved sources that are both cheaper and earlier saves USD 17.9K. The stock bridge alone holds the date at no cost, so the trade-off is USD 17.9K of savings against moving four lines away from a local supplier that is only out for two weeks. The priority truck is the fallback if the hangar cannot hold riveting until 28 Oct, but it still leaves a 2 day slip.

qa.answer: Four options. Bridge WO-2620 from stock with riveting sequenced after 27 Oct and move four pin lines to cheaper approved sources (saves USD 17.9K, no slip, recommended), the stock bridge alone (no cost, no slip), a priority restart batch by Causeway Trucking (USD 15.2K including 2 days of LDs), or accept the slip and pay Orchid Regional Airways USD 16K in LDs.

The recommended option is the cheapest at a USD 17.9K net saving. Hsinchu shear pins are USD 20 below Shah Alam, Kingsbury USD 26 below and Saone clevis pins USD 17 below, across 863 pins on four lines. The stock bridge for WO-2620 itself costs nothing.

In 2024 a seal batch failed receiving and we reallocated released stock from a later work order, then backfilled two weeks before it was needed (PRE-09); the induction held. The same lever works here because WO-2611 does not induct until 12 Nov and the 27 Oct delivery repays it. The 2024 Taiwan typhoon case (PRE-06) used US distributor stock, but no approved distributor holds these rivets.

WO-2620 needs 12,000 monel blind rivets at induction on 19 Oct. The fire moves Shah Alam's delivery to 27 Oct, an 8 day slip against 4 days of float, so Orchid Regional Airways' redelivery moves 4 days to 16 Nov. Saone Rivets quotes 28 days, landing 4 Nov, so switching source would make it worse.
